thread:
noah-p: hi all, I'm Noah (joined platform team today). Trying to get kubectl talking to the redwood clusters. I copied a vendor kubeconfig into ~/Downloads and tried merging but `kubectl config get-contexts` still only shows my minikube. any tips?

devex-ana: welcome Noah! :wave: For most of us we use the infra helper or rwd-kube to merge safely. What command did you use to merge?

noah-p: I just used `cat vendor-config >> ~/.kube/config` which I realize is probably blind. I see duplicate users and no new redwood contexts.

sam-infra: hey Noah, that cat append pattern can corrupt the YAML structure. Try a safe flatten: `KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/config:~/Downloads/vendor-config kubectl config view --flatten > /tmp/k && mv /tmp/k ~/.kube/config` — that merges without mangling. Also check $KUBECONFIG env before running.

noah-p: thanks! running that now. quick q: do I need any permissions to list pods in redwood-dev and ml-experiments?

sam-infra: you'll need rolebindings for those namespaces. The normal flow is to request access via infractl or ping infra for a one-off. If you post your corp email I can open a ticket.

noah-p: noah.p@redwood.com

infra-bot: Ticket KUBE-5488 created for noah.p@redwood.com: request access to namespaces redwood-dev, ml-experiments. Assigned to sam-infra.

sre-liz: small safety note: make sure your merged config doesn't include any `user: token` that matches a prod service account. If you're ever in doubt, tag me and we'll scrub it.

noah-p: merge worked, I can see contexts `redwood-dev/noah-p` and `redwood-staging/noah-p` now. Trying `kubectl get ns` gives Forbidden without the rolebinding.

sam-infra: approved and rolebinding applied to group platform-developers for redwood-dev; ml-experiments needs an exception because it's gated — I added you to the pending list and asked experiments team for access.

infra-bot: KUBE-5488 updated: rolebinding applied in redwood-dev; access requested for ml-experiments, awaiting approvals.

noah-p: verified `kubectl get pods -n redwood-dev` works. ml-experiments still 403. Thanks so much everyone! :raised_hands:
